column7: REVIEW-2 on #3367: UpdateRole was classified grant-shaped and failed closed even when it only removed permissions, so a revocation was blocked by the audit log (against the rule that a revocation never is). It is now classified per call from what it changed in its transaction: any assigned permission (mixed included) fails closed, a removal-only or description-only update commits and audits best-effort after the commit. Red on the PR head: 4/4 narrow and no-op cases per backend refused with ErrMutationAuditUnavailable; widen and mixed stay fail-closed (green both ways). Companion TestSecurityMutationAudit_UpdateSharePermission_ByDirection covers share updates.
